hints.content: Imagine that the plane slices the solid figure.  The slice cuts through the block of butter vertically and is parallel to the front side of the block of butter. The shape of the slice is the same as the front side of the block of butter.
The block of butter has the shape of a right regular prism and its front side is a square.

The shape of the vertical intersection shown in the figure is a square.  
![square](${☣ LOCALPATH}/images/5e41852c0f2495a3f8a8d4ec16e69c96.png)

question.content:
The figure below shows a block of butter.



[[☃ image 1]]

**Which shape does the intersection of the vertical plane with the block of butter look like?**

[[☃ radio 1]]

options.alt: A block of butter that is in the shape of a rectangular prism with a rectangle through it that represents the cross-section. The rectangle is at an angle so that it is perpendicular to an base of the rectangular prism. The rectangle moves through the entire rectangular prism showing every possible cross-section. It cross-section includes a square.
